title: Into the Pool
style: sparse ambient piano, 72 BPM, single note melody, long reverb tail, near silence between notes, warm but eerie, survival theme, no drums, breath sounds audible, intimate male vocal NZ/AU accent, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — single piano note, long reverb]

[VERSE 1 — quiet, no rush]
No fence around the water
No sound at all
I walked right in like I owned it
I didn't fall — I sank

The sun was there above me
Getting bigger — getting bright
Not afraid of anything
Not even the light

[CHORUS — still minimal, one note added]
Into the pool
Calm as I ever was
Into the pool
Before I knew what loss was
The world got white
The sun got close
I wasn't afraid
I was almost home

[VERSE 2]
No memory of panic
No fight at the edge
Just the water coming over
And the light on the ledge

Then the hands came
Then the surface
Then the noise of it all
I don't remember being afraid
Only the fall

[OUTRO — piano alone]
Into the pool.
Not afraid.
Not afraid.
